name: app-hand-held-banking-app-beside-business-impact-bar-chart-poster
title: Banking App in Hand beside Impact Chart Poster
whatItIs: A split image: at left a hand holds a pearl-grey banking app phone against a wall with a hard shadow; at right a white poster on a steel truss frame shows a business impact headline and a stepped bar chart of quarterly figures.
whatItMeans: Pairing a product shot with a physical poster of results links the app to its business value, in one calm monochrome.
techniques: Hard directional shadow on the wall
Stepped bar chart drawn with hatch fills
Steel truss as a physical stand
Two equal panels side by side
Red eyebrow label as the only colour

vocabulary.definition: A crisp-edged shadow from strong light.
A pattern of fine diagonal lines used to fill shapes.
A small coloured label above a heading.
